notes: INSIDE half of the Mire Mist Projector: two upright water tanks (cyan, a bubble rising on the loop) and a steel pump block with a piston, power coupling and the five water-gauge tubes. damaged: a tank weeps and the pump stutters; disabled: tanks cracked and dry. The rotating head mire_mist_projector_barrel swivels in the ring: a teal head with a fan of three brass spray nozzles and a sensor eye.
